Layer.InitCommand: %function(self) self:x( SCREEN_CENTER_X ) self:y( SCREEN_CENTER_Y+150 ) self:zoom(0.5) end
%function(self) self:x( SCREEN_CENTER_X ) self:y( SCREEN_CENTER_Y+170 ) self:zoom(0.5) end

Layer.ShowScoreCommand: %function(self) self:settext( GetScore(PLAYER_1) ) self:zoom(0) self:sleep(0.2*7) self:bounceend(0.4) self:zoom(1) end
%function(self) self:settext( GetScore(PLAYER_2) ) self:zoom(0) self:sleep(0.2*7) self:bounceend(0.4) self:zoom(1) end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X-70) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+78) self:shadowlength(0) self:diffuse(1,0,0,1) self:horizalign('right') self:zoom(0) self:sleep(0.125*7) self:queuecommand('CalcMine') self:bounceend(0.4) self:zoom(0.4) end
Layer.CalcMineCommand: %function(self) local MineTxt = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('MinesTextP1'):GetText() local MinePass = string.gsub(MineTxt, '/.*', '') MinePass = string.gsub(MinePass,' ','') local MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTxt, '^.*/', '') MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTotal,' ','') local MineHit = tostring(tonumber(MineTotal) - tonumber(MinePass)) if tonumber(MineHit) > 0 then self:settext('+'..MineHit) end end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X+70) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+78) self:shadowlength(0) self:diffuse(1,0,0,1) self:horizalign('left') self:zoom(0) self:sleep(0.125*7) self:queuecommand('CalcMine') self:bounceend(0.4) self:zoom(0.4) end
Layer.CalcMineCommand: %function(self) local MineTxt = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('MinesTextP2'):GetText() local MinePass = string.gsub(MineTxt, '/.*', '') MinePass = string.gsub(MinePass,' ','') local MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTxt, '^.*/', '') MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTotal,' ','') local MineHit = tostring(tonumber(MineTotal) - tonumber(MinePass)) if tonumber(MineHit) > 0 then self:settext('+'..MineHit) end end

Layer.PlaySoundCommand: %function(self) RandomNumber = math.random(1,7) AudioClipToPlay = AnnouncerAudio() AudioPlay( AudioClipToPlay ) end
